snippet.title: Fright Train ┃ Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
What happens when you mix Resident Evil 4 with classic Call of Duty Zombies and set it on a train in Antarctica?

An action survival horror roguelite with animal characters, obviously!

Fright Train is a third-person action survival horror roguelite in which you'll explore the monster-ridden corridors of an enormous train speeding through Antarctica. 

Keep it running by maintaining its parts, because if the train stops, there’s no telling what abomination might emerge from the blizzard to claim you...
